title: Ma voix spéciale
oneGoal: Students discover their voice as a tool for communication
progression: Foundation lesson - introduces voice as communication tool
realWorldConnection: We use our voices every day to talk to family and friends

title: Montrer et dire
oneGoal: Students bring something special to share with simple French words
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by using voice to share personal items
realWorldConnection: Show and tell helps us share what's important to us

title: Gestes qui parlent
oneGoal: Students use gestures and body language to communicate meaning
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by adding non-verbal communication
realWorldConnection: Our bodies help us communicate even without words

title: Écouter avec attention
oneGoal: Students practice being good listeners and asking simple questions
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by focusing on the listening side of communication
realWorldConnection: Good communication means both talking and listening

title: Raconter mes aventures
oneGoal: Students tell simple personal stories using sequence words
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by structuring personal storytelling
realWorldConnection: We tell family about our adventures and experiences

title: Personnages vivants
oneGoal: Students use different voices and movements for simple characters
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by adding character work to storytelling
realWorldConnection: We change our voices when we pretend to be different people

title: Émotions expressives
oneGoal: Students express different emotions through voice and face
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by adding emotional expression
realWorldConnection: Our faces and voices show how we feel

title: Jouer des scènes
oneGoal: Students act out simple everyday scenarios with partners
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by combining skills in dramatic play
realWorldConnection: We act out different situations in our daily play

title: Présenter mes créations
oneGoal: Students present their artwork or projects with simple descriptions
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by presenting personal work
realWorldConnection: Artists explain their work to help others understand

title: Questions curieuses
oneGoal: Students ask thoughtful questions about classmates' presentations
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by becoming active audience members
realWorldConnection: Asking questions shows we're interested in others

title: Instructions claires
oneGoal: Students give simple instructions for games or activities
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by using communication to guide others
realWorldConnection: We give instructions to help others learn new things

title: Descriptions vivantes
oneGoal: Students describe people, places, or things with vivid details
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by adding descriptive language skills
realWorldConnection: Good descriptions help others picture what we're talking about

title: Spectacle de classe
oneGoal: Students perform in a simple class presentation showcasing their skills
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by combining all communication skills
realWorldConnection: Performers share their talents with audiences

title: Portfolio de communication
oneGoal: Students reflect on their growth as French communicators
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by reflecting on communication journey
realWorldConnection: We can see how much better we've become at sharing ideas

title: Conteurs d'histoires
oneGoal: Students create and tell elaborate stories with multiple characters
progression: Extension - applies storytelling skills to complex narratives
realWorldConnection: Storytellers entertain people with creative tales

title: Reporters de nouvelles
oneGoal: Students report on classroom or school events like news reporters
progression: Extension - uses communication skills for informational purposes
realWorldConnection: Reporters tell people about important events

title: Débat amical
oneGoal: Students share different opinions respectfully on simple topics
progression: Extension - explores respectful disagreement and discussion
realWorldConnection: People can have different ideas and still be friends

title: Enseignants experts
oneGoal: Students teach younger students or family members something new
progression: Extension - uses communication skills to teach others
realWorldConnection: We can teach others what we've learned

title: Ambassadeurs culturels
oneGoal: Students share aspects of their culture through creative communication
progression: Extension - connects communication to cultural identity
realWorldConnection: We can share our family traditions with others

title: Célébration de communicateurs
oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth as confident French communicators
progression: Extension - culminates unit with celebration of communication growth
realWorldConnection: Confident communicators can share ideas with anyone
